title: Global River Width from Landsat — raw vector observations V01.01
description: Complete GRWL V01.01 raw vector observations in lossless GeoParquet, with one separately versioned zoom 0–12 PMTiles display. Zooms 0–7 show selected widest original width observations with source IDs; zooms 8–12 preserve detailed source geometry and widths. All 64,572,998 observations and ten original DBF fields remain in GeoParquet. Complete source comparison, analytical rebuild, full global overview validation, exact detailed-tile preservation, clean regional replay and all 20 browser cases passed. These releases are prepared locally; no product has been created or uploaded.
